tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Today we will discuss how different factors affect educational outcomes. Clearly, the quality of teaching and the school resources available to students play a significant role in their academic success. On the other hand, some people believe that a student's home environment and parental involvement are just as important—if not more important. Which do you believe plays a larger role in a student's educational outcomes? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think that the home environment and parental involvement are crucial. Students who have supportive parents and a stable home life tend to perform better academically. Parents who are involved in their child's education can provide additional support and encouragement, which can make a big difference in the student's motivation and performance.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe that the quality of teaching and the resources available at school are more important. Even if a student comes from a challenging home environment, having access to good teachers and educational resources can help that student succeed. Schools that provide a positive learning environment and the necessary tools for learning can significantly impact a student's academic achievements.
